focus: Practical software engineering, scientific research tools, and automation across sectors
title: From Flexible JSON to Reliable Workflows: Make Data Dependencies Explicit
utility_use_case: A research team receives semi-structured JSON from several instruments and needs to validate records, normalize fields, run identifier and quality checks, and publish a cleaned dataset. Encode those steps and prerequisites in `dependencies.json`, then run `bash dependency-order.sh --file dependencies.json` during review or as a lightweight preflight check. The output exposes a valid deterministic sequence or flags a graph that cannot be fully ordered. Researchers still need to inspect the data and verify that the declared prerequisites reflect the actual scientific workflow.
